partition: Three chronological thirds of the entire declared METHOD session span, floor(N*i/3) boundaries; missing slots remain unknown
carry_in: Preceding boundary NAV, cash and actual saved lots; no capital reset, refit, reinvestment or concatenated performance claim
missing_boundary: No exact saved boundary state means unknown carry-in, not last observation carried forward
qualification: Known hard drawdown breach retains FAIL; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS; METHOD slots are not real trading-calendar evidence
